plugin.name: NetBird
plugin.description: Lists the peers of your NetBird network, adds them as hosts and checks whether your access policies let Termix reach their SSH port.

panel.notConfigured: Set the NetBird API token in Settings, Plugins, NetBird.
panel.apiError: The NetBird management API could not be read.
panel.empty: No peers in this NetBird network.
panel.termixPeerMissing: The Termix peer from the settings is not in this network.
panel.termixPeerUnset: Set the Termix peer in the settings to check SSH reachability.

reach.postureChecks: Posture checks apply and can still block the connection.
reach.blockedHint: No NetBird policy lets the Termix peer open TCP {{port}} to this peer.

view.title: View NetBird peers
view.description: See every peer of the NetBird network, its groups and which policies reach it.

managementUrl.label: Management URL
managementUrl.description: Your self-hosted management server, for example https://vpn.example.com. Leave empty for NetBird Cloud.

apiToken.label: API token
apiToken.description: A personal access token of a NetBird service account. Read access is enough; an auditor role is recommended.

termixPeer.label: Termix peer
termixPeer.description: The NetBird peer this Termix server runs on: its name, DNS label or NetBird IP. Used for the SSH reachability check.

sshPort.label: SSH port
sshPort.description: The port the reachability check and new hosts use.
